top_level.sites: Sequence of {element:str,frac_coords:3 floats,occupancy:float}; H2 sites are fully occupied ordered elemental sites; coordinates wrapped to[0,1). No site properties.
top_level.neighbors: Sequence of {i:int,j:int,image:3 ints,distance_A:float}; directed periodic neighbors at6.0A, numerical_tol1e-8, exclude_self=True (only zero-image self excluded); image translates j. Sort by(i,distance_A,j,image). No truncation/padding.
top_level.composition: element-symbol -> atomic fraction, positive fractions sum to1
top_level.element_properties: element-symbol -> table below; absent/nonfinite values are None and named in missing_fields
top_level.volume_per_atom_A3: cell volume divided by sum occupancies
top_level.basic_structure_statistics: The9 values in simple_structure_features; no fit or label-derived quantities

element_property_fields.covalent_radius_A: Cordero radius from pymatgen CovalentRadius.radius, Angstrom or None
element_property_fields.valence_electrons: Let n be the periodic-table row. Count occupied n-shell electrons plus(n-1)d for d/f-block and(n-2)f for f-block. Filled d/f subshells count for their block. The period rather than highest occupied n handles anomalous empty ns shells such as Pd. Geometry-independent convention, not oxidation state.
element_property_fields.pymatgen_valence_subshell: pymatgen Element.valence tuple(l,occupancy), or None; distinct from the scalar convention above
element_property_fields.first_ionization_energy_eV: first pymatgen ionization_energies entry, eV or None
element_property_fields.missing_fields: Sequence naming every missing/invalid property; None remains explicit, no dataset imputation

simple_structure_definitions.distance_statistics: Min/mean/population std(ddof=0) over the directed6A neighbor entries, in Angstrom; if no entries all3 are0.
simple_structure_definitions.coordination_statistics: Count directed6A neighbors for every site including periodic images; population mean/std(ddof=0) across all n_sites, including zeros for isolated sites; no division by2.

field_spec.label_exclusion: No record/source/template ID, split, target, energy, force, convergence, original metadata, provenance, path, site/global property, magmom or prediction enters the feature dictionary or memory-probe packet. Atomic ionization energy/electron affinity are permitted tabulated elemental properties only.
field_spec.structure_choice: H2 final_structure when available; initial_structure only as geometry fallback for a failed real record in the full DFT arm. This never fabricates a missing CHGNet target.
field_spec.read_only: Trusted h3_data.FrozenDict subclasses of dict with recursively frozen tuple containers; freeze/thaw for deterministic transport; no ndarray objects in the serialized input.

data.membership_method: Exact H2/H3 S0500 plus 1500 remaining IDs ordered by SHA256(H2-S0-topup-v1|seed|id), final IDs sorted
data.inner_split_method: Distinct template groups ordered SHA256(H3-CGCNN-inner-v1|seed|group); first ceil(20% groups) validation; no group overlap
data.prompt_examples_scope: this seed's frozen POOL2000 only; no TEST/HOLDOUT labels
data.TEST_truth_access: One terminal read for all three seeds after phase4_1/evaluation_started.json

query_metadata_audit.template_spacegroup_note: No template space-group field is stored in H2 row or cached H3 structure; stage4.1 makes no query and does not infer one.

prompts.feature_prefix:
Write 1 to 20 distinct scalar material descriptors to complement Magpie composition features in an HGB formation-energy regressor. This is an independent one-shot candidate: no other candidate, validation result, or feedback is supplied. Use only the labeled examples and summary below. Return exactly {"features":[{"name":...,"description":...,"source":...},...]}.
Each source must define exactly def feature(s), returning one finite float when possible; no helpers, decorators, annotations or outside code. Do not return predictions, fitted models, material lookup tables or duplicate/scaled copies. The label is absent from s; formula/example identifiers and experimental metadata are unavailable to code. Handle empty sequences and missing None elemental values.
s is the original recursively readonly H3 dictionary, with only:
lattice: matrix (3x3 row vectors Angstrom), lengths_A=[a,b,c], angles_deg=[alpha,beta,gamma], a_A,b_A,c_A,alpha_deg,beta_deg,gamma_deg,volume_A3.
sites: sequence of {element:str,frac_coords:[x,y,z] wrapped [0,1),occupancy:float}.
neighbors: all directed periodic neighbors within 6 Angstrom, {i:int,j:int,image:[int,int,int],distance_A:float}; image translates j; zero-image self excluded, no truncation.
composition: element->atomic fraction. n_sites:int; n_elements:int; volume_per_atom_A3; density_g_cm3.
element_properties: element->{Z,group,row,eneg,covalent_radius_A,mass_amu,valence_electrons,pymatgen_valence_subshell,first_ionization_energy_eV,electron_affinity_eV,melting_point_K,boiling_point_K,atomic_radius_A,missing_fields}. Missing numeric values are None. Valence counts outer period-shell electrons plus (n-1)d for d/f and (n-2)f for f-block; not oxidation states. Subshell is (l,occupancy) or None. Atomic tabulated ionization energy/affinity are permitted, never formation-energy labels.
basic_structure_statistics: volume_per_atom_A3,density_g_cm3,min_neighbor_distance_6A_A,mean_neighbor_distance_6A_A,std_neighbor_distance_6A_A,mean_coordination_6A,std_coordination_6A,lattice_anisotropy,max_angle_deviation_from90_deg. Distance std and per-site coordination std use ddof=0; coordination includes images. Empty distances give zero. Anisotropy=max(a,b,c)/min(a,b,c).
Use Python numeric expressions/local variables, if/for/while, lists/tuples/dicts and comprehensions. Only preprovided math, np and pure builtins below. No import, I/O, filesystem/network, reflection, private/double-underscore attributes, eval/exec, dynamic calls, recursion, randomness, mutation of inputs, or object dtype. Per function: 20000 source characters, 2500 AST nodes; per structure execution limit 50 ms. AST-invalid functions are recorded as failed, not repaired. Runtime failures/timeouts become NaN. Features failing on more than 20% of training rows are removed; held-out failures never choose features.

source.description: Exactly one top-level def feature(s); no other definitions or top-level code.

prompts.instructions: Return only final JSON matching the response schema. Tools are forbidden. Do not use files, shell, network, or external services. Do not include chain-of-thought or reasoning steps.
prompts.format_repair_suffix: FORMAT REPAIR ONLY: Return exactly the requested JSON schema with all required fields. No tools, files, examples, or additional information are available.
prompts.summary_policy: All frozen POOL2000; labels may include internal validation rows; no TEST/HOLDOUT target or feedback
prompts.AST_invalid_features: scientific failure records; never trigger a format-repair request

models.selection: minimum row validation MAE; exact ties earliest index
models.final_mask: fullTRAIN2000 only after selecting the candidate; no TEST selection

statistics.group_weight: inverse count of this template in the complete TEST1000
statistics.bootstrap: within-domain template-group multinomial resampling; shared draws across all three seeds; percentile95 intervals
statistics.seed_aggregation: arithmetic mean of seed-specific metrics and their paired bootstrap draws; never a prediction ensemble or best seed
statistics.terminal_policy: one stage-global marker; one TEST1000 accessor call supplies all three seeds; no partial-subset scoring

operational.format_repair_suffix: FORMAT REPAIR ONLY: Return exactly the requested JSON schema with all required fields. No tools, files, examples, or additional information are available.
operational.forecast_formula: elapsed pilot + remaining logical request mean latency/4 + remaining candidate mean wall + 3*mean candidate wall for winners + 600s terminal/audit allowance
operational.per_candidate_resume: whole unfinished candidate only; successful requests/candidates immutable

stage_boundary.future_query_template_spacegroup: not present in H2; must freeze separate label-free template metadata before stage4.2
